head_coach.name: Gustavo Alfaro
head_coach.play_style_summary: A highly pragmatic, disciplined low-block structure focusing on intense physical duels, restricting central spaces, rapid counter-attacking vertical transitions, and structured set pieces.

key_players.name: Julio Enciso
key_players.performance_stats: Averages 1.27 shots on target per match, won 157 duels, 79% pass completion rate, and provides elite playmaking with creative dribbling capacity.

key_players.name: Diego Gómez
key_players.performance_stats: Maintains an 85% pass completion rate, averages 1.8 tackles per match, and serves as a highly versatile box-to-box midfielder with exceptional stamina.

key_players.name: Ramón Sosa
key_players.performance_stats: Explosive winger with a 74.1% pass completion rate, averaging 1.1 key passes per match, and excels at running into space and attacking in 1v1 transitions.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Thigh/quadriceps injury suffered on June 5, 2026, during a friendly match against Nicaragua; currently under monitoring and doubtful for the group stage opening matches.
